dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert heuristics not usually restated by a baseline model: explicit version‑bump rules, deep‑merge semantics of configuration merge, prohibition of presigned URLs, hard vs soft dependency behavior, token‑exchange role policy details, and Docker artifact type handling. Missing only a few niche edge‑cases (e.g., multi‑arch component platforms, region‑specific defaults).

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific end‑to‑end procedure: ordered CLI commands, prerequisite verification, dependency graph sequencing, and deployment policy settings. Procedure is detailed and domain‑specific. Slight deduction for occasional generic phrasing (e.g., "verify core device is healthy") without a concrete command checklist.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a detailed "NEVER" list (10 items) with concrete reasoning for each pitfall (e.g., never use presigned URLs, never deploy to individual devices). Missing a couple of niche anti‑patterns such as forgetting IAM policy for Secrets Manager, so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, dependencies, metadata). Description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides exhaustive activation keywords. No missing fields.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document layers information (quick navigation, mindset, detailed steps, never list, output format, examples). However, the top‑level contains a large amount of detail, which can cause cognitive overload before the agent reaches the concise checklist, so it falls short of optimal progressive disclosure.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates freedom appropriately: destructive actions (actual deployment) are limited to checklist output; creative tasks (recipe authoring) are guided but not auto‑executed. Deducted one point for not explicitly constraining optional advanced scenarios (e.g., private registry login) which could be risky if mis‑used.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (frontmatter, quick navigation, mindset, stepwise process, never list, output format, examples). The pattern is consistent but not explicitly labeled as a known framework, making it marginally less than perfect.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a ready‑to‑use checklist, exact AWS CLI commands, verification steps, and worked examples that an agent can execute cold. Missing some edge‑case handling (e.g., private Docker registry authentication, IAM least‑privilege policy validation, multi‑region bucket naming) and limited guidance on troubleshooting failed deployments, leading to a modest deduction.
